requests.name: rounded-back
requests.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Image 1 is a HEADLESS continuous body layer of the dew rabbit for 2D animation. Image 2 is the original complete rabbit design reference. Repair the UPPER BACK AND SHOULDER silhouette of image 1 where the head and ears used to hide it. It is visibly flat and sliced across the top. Paint the complete underlying rounded furry body, with a single natural convex back/shoulder curve: from the front shoulder around (220,295), rising through (285,265), rounding over the upper rump near (340,275), then flowing down to the existing rump. No flat shelf, horizontal cutoff, missing triangular wedge or abrupt pointed stub. This must look like the back of the same soft round rabbit when the head bows forward and the ears move away. Draw all the previously hidden cream fur surface across the upper body. Keep the rest of the body, chest collar with its two mint dew drops, connected forelegs, hindquarter, paws and tail exactly as they are, with the same scale, positions, colors, soft brushwork and grounded toes. Do NOT add a head, a skull, ears, eyes or a tall neck stump. A rounded underlying torso, not a second head. Retain this full 512x512 world-space source canvas and its transparent margins; original paw ground line about y443 and rear edge about x425. No recentering or zoom, no background or shadow, no text. This is the actual finished production layer.

requests.name: drawn-ear-fall
requests.prompt:
Production 2D animation artwork, NOT a preview. Create a 4 columns by 4 rows exact uniform square-cell spritesheet, 16 consecutive FULL HEAD WITH BOTH EARS drawings of this exact dew rabbit. Image 1 is the locked closed-eye head appearance and local canvas; image 2 supplies the original ear designs. Target 2048x2048 sheet with 512x512 world-space cells, read left to right then top to bottom. Every cell must have the same fixed head and face position, scale, silhouette, cream fur brushwork, closed eyes, pink nose, lighting and left-facing 3/4 camera. In each cell, head muzzle near (135,292), near eyelid near (228,284), skull top near (224,205), chin near (220,350), left/far ear attachment near (228,210), right/near ear attachment near (272,225). Keep the head absolutely motionless and identically shaped throughout: ONLY the ears move. Do NOT fit, recenter or zoom each drawing. Transparent margins unchanged. No body, neck collar, paws or tail. All 16 are actual finished animation source drawings.
Motion: one smooth gravity-driven loss of support in the two long, thick mint-lined furry ears. Frame 1 shows the original ear pose: the image-left far ear already bends leftward, the larger image-right near ear points up-right. Frames 2-4 begin to loosen at the true scalp attachments, with the tips lagging. Frames 5-8 lower BOTH ears OUTWARD toward their respective sides: left ear rotates toward image-left/down, right ear rotates toward image-right/down. Frames 9-12 show the ears bending softly around their own cartilage, tips following down; the roots are joined smoothly to the skull and never become white cuffs, cut paper caps, dangling knots or separate pieces. Frames 13-16 settle the ears down along the OUTSIDES of the cheeks. Final left ear bends left and down with tip around (100,340), final right ear bends right and down with tip around (365,345). Keep both ear leaves outside the face rather than passing through the forehead or rolling over the crown. Keep their broad mint interiors and cream fur borders readable, original physical length and volume intact, no sudden shrinking. The small attached dew drops stay attached and hang downward naturally.
Paint every root as REAL continuous anatomy with the scalp, appropriate changing folds, hidden fur, contact shading and overlapping edges. Each complete drawing must have fully painted skull, ear roots and exposed surfaces, with NO raw cut or horizontal seam anywhere. Do not rotate a separate bulbous root as a rigid cuff. No triangular gaps, duplicated root tufts, detached fragments, geometric clipping, sliced outlines, motion blur, ghosting, fade, crossfade or semitransparent poses. Closed eyes and face do not change at all. No text, labels, borders, grid lines, scenery or shadows outside the character. Genuine transparent background. This entire sheet will be sliced and played directly as actual drawings.
